description: This is a PHP class file defining the Service class within the AWS SDK, representing a web service API model with methods for creating serializers and parsers, accessing service metadata, operations, paginators, waiters, and managing the service definition.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a web service API model with capabilities for managing operations, error shapes, pagination, waiters, and service metadata. Provides methods for creating serializers/parsers and accessing service details.

methods.name: createSerializer
methods.description: Creates a request serializer object based on the API's protocol.

methods.name: createErrorParser
methods.description: Creates an error parser for the specified protocol, optionally taking a Service instance.

methods.name: createParser
methods.description: Creates a response parser for the service based on its protocol.

methods.name: getServiceFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the service.

methods.name: getServiceId
methods.description: Returns the service ID.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.description: Returns the API version.

methods.name: getEndpointPrefix
methods.description: Returns the endpoint prefix for the service.

methods.name: getSigningName
methods.description: Returns the signing name used by the service, defaulting to endpoint prefix if not specified.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the service name.

methods.name: getSignatureVersion
methods.description: Returns the default signature version ('v4' if not specified).

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol used by the service.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Returns the UID string used by the service.

methods.name: hasOperation
methods.description: Checks if a specific operation exists by name.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Retrieves an Operation object by name, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Retrieves all operations defined in the service.

methods.name: getErrorShapes
methods.description: Retrieves all shapes defined as exceptions in the service.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Accesses service metadata or a specific key.

methods.name: getPaginators
methods.description: Retrieves paginator configurations.

methods.name: hasPaginator
methods.description: Checks if a paginator exists by name.

methods.name: getPaginatorConfig
methods.description: Gets configuration for a specific paginator.

methods.name: getWaiters
methods.description: Retrieves waiter configurations.

methods.name: hasWaiter
methods.description: Checks if a waiter exists by name.

methods.name: getWaiterConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a waiter's configuration by name.

methods.name: getShapeMap
methods.description: Returns the shape map used by the API.

methods.name: getClientContextParams
methods.description: Returns the client context parameters.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the API provider callable.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the service definition.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the service definition and marks the model as modified.

methods.name: isModifiedModel
methods.description: Indicates if the model has been modified.
